text_block_list.text:
After a fierce and heated race, Grass
Wonder
comes out on top!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Victory is hers, but she can't find the
words to
describe the feeling. All she
can do is bask in the
afterglow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now she looks ahead to her second,
more
focused shot at the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Спешл Уик, who was spectating
today's race, is
left speechless by her
friends' ever-growing
abilities. As she
stares on in shock, Марузенски

approaches her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Марузенски's words,
Спешл Уик
breaks through her
complex feelings and runs off,

inspiration rekindled.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
